text: Slice 6 plan. Part A: the factory amends existing projects. It shows a diff of the statements, records which proposal each ratification amends, and synthesizes from the current code. Scope allows a lock change only with this issue's ratification, amending the lock on the base branch. Part B: the factory's own issue protocol becomes its first self-hosted project, proved with Gobra, and the watcher runs on it. An issue names its project with a `Project:` line. Amendments may remove or weaken statements, called out in bold, and may amend hand-built projects.
